task_pool.source: Reuse the TIERED 2842 held-out task prompts from heldout_sft_corpus_tiered.jsonl (secJ8). Each pair already carries a non-eval `instruction` (held-out task prompt) + `doctest_code` (reference example = pass-oracle).
task_pool.reason: 造题 / check.py is designflow's job (本线使命: 不是主业). secK reuses the held-out prompts secI/secJ already produced; it does NOT synthesize new tasks or check functions.

trajectory_generation_protocol.model: base MiniCPM5-2B (GPU4 :8098 standby) for base预演, OR BaiZe pretrain ckpt (ETA approx 2026-12-25) for formal run
trajectory_generation_protocol.harness: cline harness, A0 口径: search_apis / get_api_details / run_code / editor / submit_and_exit
trajectory_generation_protocol.anti_cheat: PreToolUse hook enabled, identical across all arms (sec5.2)
trajectory_generation_protocol.parallelism: -p 8 -n (frozen eval protocol; serial discipline vs zhulong: pgrep run_cline_script empty + ss port check before start)

pass_oracle.rule: A held-out task 'passes' if the trajectory submits executable code whose behavior matches the reference doctest. Execution happens in the EDA sandbox (run_code via dual-nix-tunnel) during the RUN; the runner records pass_verdict.
pass_oracle.honesty_note: Some doctest examples lack assertions; for those, pass = code executes without error AND produces the documented output shape. Ambiguous cases are dropped (not forced to pass).

contamination_gate.source: secH4 re-check on the harvested REAL trajectory code surface
rules: excluded HIGH-risk helpers (dbNewCV, dbCreateLib) must NOT appear in trajectory code
no eval entry-point `def <name>(` signature may leak

behavior_gate.rationale: A1 SFT collapsed to search_apis -82% + submit_and_exit +451% (storm) + F1_no_code. Healthy template (secG3) = search -> get_details -> editor -> run_code -> fix -> submit ONCE.
behavior_gate.on_fail: drop trajectory + log reason (do NOT relax thresholds post-hoc)

mix.formal_sft_corpus: TIERED 2842 doc->code pairs + harvested real agentic trajectories (pass both gates)
mix.rationale: secF root cause = 0% agentic in A1 SFT corpus. Pre-registered >= 30% real agentic share to fix the deployment-distribution mismatch.
mix.on_share_below_min: harvest more trajectories (do NOT lower the threshold); if still below after exhausting the pool, report honestly as blocked, do not ship a < 30% corpus as 'fixed'

blocked_pre_requisites: served base/pretrain ckpt on GPU4 :8098 (or pretrain ckpt ETA approx 2026-12-25)
dual-nix-tunnel sandbox up (ssh -p 3333 -> 36.15, run_code e2e PASS)
serial discipline vs zhulong (pgrep run_cline_script empty + ss -tlnp port check)

prereg_judgement_for_eval.gate: Formal SFT corpus must pass TIERED gate + contamination_gate + behavior_gate AND agentic_share >= 30%
prereg_judgement_for_eval.success: post-SFT delta > 0 AND paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 vs A0 (secF5.5)
prereg_judgement_for_eval.behavior_sentinel: post-SFT search_apis frequency >= base*0.5 AND submit_and_exit <= base*2.0; collapse => SFT failed, stop and redo BEFORE looking at Pass@1 (secF5.3)
